project.name: VibeControl
project.tagline: Visual Architecture, Codebase Intelligence & Rolling-Wave Control for Vibe Coding
project.proposalSummary: VibeControl replaces static markdown task plans and chaotic chat sessions with an active multi-graph repository control system. It provides an embedded Single Source of Truth (.project-control), an interactive React Flow dashboard, zero-drift codebase intelligence, and rolling-wave prompt compilation for AI coding agents.

activeHorizonTasks.title: Core Data Schemas, Multi-Graph State & Validator
activeHorizonTasks.description: Define multi-layer JSON/Zod schemas, bootstrap .project-control dogfooding state, and build the validation CLI script.
acceptanceCriteria: Package.json initialized with ESM and minimal dependencies
scripts/schemas.mjs created with comprehensive Zod schemas
scripts/validate-control.mjs implemented and passes with 0 errors

activeHorizonTasks.title: CLI Context Compiler & Task Finisher
activeHorizonTasks.description: Implement CLI utilities to compile active task context into high-signal prompts for coding agents and mark completed tasks while advancing the rolling wave.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/compile-prompt.mjs outputs minimal, high-signal task prompt
scripts/complete-task.mjs archives completed task and rolls to next task
activity.jsonl receives task completion and rolling wave update entries
Cross-reference validation confirms zero broken references after rolling
activeHorizonTasks.notes: Follows immediately upon completion of TASK-01
